claimBoundary.purpose: Fresh known-brief diagnostic of final Creator vNext versus the frozen built-in Codex skill-creator.

C.role: final exact-reviewed Creator vNext merged through pull request 2

D.role: independent built-in baseline retained from the four-arm freeze

isolation.abortRule: A treatment is isolation-ineligible if required evidence is absent, a filesystem or network boundary fails, the process exceeds wall time, exits nonzero, or token usage is absent. Token quantity does not determine eligibility.

decisionRules.knownTaskWinner: Both treatments and both judge runs must be isolation-eligible. A recommendation needs no critical deterministic failure, at least 85 total points, and at least an 8-point lead.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any isolation failure, no treatment at 85 points, any leading treatment with a critical failure, or a lead below 8 points is inconclusive.
decisionRules.pairedRepeat: No paired repeat is part of this execution. A later repeat requires a new preregistration and cannot retroactively change this result.
decisionRules.heldOutAdmission: This known-brief run cannot promote a Creator. A later acceptance-refinement treatment requires a fixed repair budget and at least one held-out skill brief.

acceptanceRefinementHypothesis.developmentEvidence: The historical raw Grok reference scored 35/70 and the separately acceptance-refined reference scored 70/70.
acceptanceRefinementHypothesis.candidateMechanism: Bounded generate-test-classify-repair-repeat-freeze loop with immutable raw output and evidence-linked deltas.
acceptanceRefinementHypothesis.requiredFutureEvidence: Equal execution budget plus at least one held-out skill brief not used to design the refinement loop.

harness.hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of '<file-sha256>  <relative-path>\n' lines sorted by relative path
